newsitem.title: USA: OSHKOSH B'GOSH CLOSES DUTCH AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: OSHKOSH B'GOSH CLOSES DUTCH AUCTION.

text.p: OshKosh B'Gosh Inc said Thursday that 1,656,791 shares of Class A common stock and 41,524 shares of Class B common stock have been accepted for purchase at a price of $22.00 a share under a Dutch auction self tender offer which expired on August 6.
The self tender offer began on June 30, 1997.
Prior to the self tender offer, OshKosh B'Gosh had 10,425,571 shares of Class A common stock and 1,260,704 shares of Class B common stock outstanding.
Following the purchase of shares tendered in the sale, OshKosh B'Gosh will have about 8,768,780 shares of Class A common stock outstanding and 1,219,180 shares of Class B common stock outstanding.
Payment for shares tendered will be made on August 12, 1997.
Shares of OshKosh B'Gosh, which markets children's apparel, were trading up 1/8 to 21-3/4.
